ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: advantage_weighted_logsigmoid_pairwise_norm_relgap_shifted_scaled_powered_v1_repair
ir.intuition: This pairwise loss normalizes the advantage gap and computes a scaled powered log-sigmoid loss weighted by example weights, improving stability by clamping inputs.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon = 1e-6
shift = 0.01
adv_shifted = advantage_gap + shift
adv_centered = adv_shifted - mean(adv_shifted)
norm_adv = max(norm(adv_centered), epsilon)
diff_raw = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / norm_adv
abs_diff = abs(diff_raw)
signed_scaled_diff = sign(diff_raw) * pow(abs_diff, 0.75)
scaled_diff = scale * signed_scaled_diff
loss = -logsigmoid(scaled_diff)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
return mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-6
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.0))
    shift = 0.01
    adv_shifted = ops.add(advantage_gap, shift)
    mean_adv = ops.mean(adv_shifted)
    adv_centered = ops.sub(adv_shifted, mean_adv)
    norm_adv_raw = ops.norm(adv_centered)
    norm_adv = ops.maximum(norm_adv_raw, eps)
    diff_raw = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), norm_adv)
    abs_diff = ops.abs(diff_raw)
    # Use torch.pow directly with clamping due to no ops.pow
    abs_diff_clamped = ops.clamp(abs_diff, min=eps)
    abs_diff_pow = abs_diff_clamped.pow(0.75)
    signed_scaled_diff = ops.mul(ops.sign(diff_raw), abs_diff_pow)
    scaled_diff = ops.mul(scale, signed_scaled_diff)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    total_weight = ops.sum(weight)
    return ops.div(loss_sum, ops.maximum(total_weight, eps))
